caption: The drawing depicts a single object composed of a wall-mounted, metallic candle holder with a cylindrical, scalloped backplate and a flat base. Centered within the holder is a short, partially melted, tan-colored candle with a blackened wick. The metallic surface of the holder is rendered in shades of gray and blue, with subtle shading indicating a smooth, reflective texture. The backplate features a single, small hole near the top, suggesting it is designed to be hung on a wall. The overall composition is centered on the page, with ample empty space surrounding the object, and the background is a plain, light beige color. There is a small red stamp or mark in the lower right area near the holder.
title: Candle Holder
